extraction.NOTES: This is a general administrative letter dated December 7, 1928, from E. W. Jermark, Superintendent, Pine Ridge Agency, to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs, acknowledging receipt of a letter of December 4, 1928, regarding Circular No. 2464. Reports that 247 Indians have made statements so far. Notes that county seat records have not yet been examined but will be the following week. Notes that cases eligible for cancellation under the Act of February 26, 1927 (44 Stats.1247) require immediate action, and that previously submitted cases have seen no action in over a year. | TASK 5 RECLASSIFICATION 2026-05-03: This record was originally enumerated as CAT_1 (Sonnet missed allottee Name + Allotment), but it is NOT an allottee record — it is a cover letter from E.W. Jermark (Superintendent, Pine Ridge Agency) to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs dated 1928-12-07, reporting on Circular 2464 compliance. There is no allottee Name or Allotment to recover because the document is correspondence, not an allottee case file. Document type updated from 'agency_narrative' to 'agency_correspondence'. This record is analytically valuable as compliance/response correspondence and should remain in the corpus, but should be excluded from CAT_1 vision recovery batches.
